text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-4821 - inference-gateway - 5xx error rate > 5% (prod-usw2). Auto-page to oncall.

pagerduty: Paging oncall-jamie (primary). Escalation chain initiated.

oncall-jamie: Acked, I'm on. Starting triage — gathering quick metrics and recent deploys.

sre-miguel: On it, pulling gateway logs + k8s events for prod-usw2 now.

alice-dev: Seeing a spike of 502s originating from auth-proxy backend (/v1/token). Quick sample:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://auth.internal/v1/token -d '{"grant":"x"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
X-Request-ID: req-9f3a2
```

sre-miguel: K8s events show auth-proxy pods had liveness restarts (3x in 10m). Upstream idp-service timeouts observed in proxy logs.

oncall-jamie: Rolling restart auth-proxy deployment in prod-usw2 (graceful). Will monitor error rate and latency.

incident-bot: Action logged: k8s rollout restart deployment/auth-proxy (prod-usw2) by oncall-jamie.

alice-dev: After restart, 5xx dropped from 6.3% -> 2.5% within ~40s. Continuing to watch. :eyes:

product-anna: Any confirmed customer impact? Should we trigger status page?

support-luke: Support queue shows 3 new tickets reporting failed requests (east coast). Marked P2/P1 depending on customer. I'll keep them updated.

sre-miguel: Hypothesis: token refresh cache + burst traffic created a race that caused upstream timeouts and pod restarts. Will propose bumping timeouts + circuit breaker on idp upstream. Filing follow-up ticket.

oncall-jamie: Temporary mitigation: shift traffic off the troubled auth instance (reduce route weight) and keep restart in place.

incident-bot: Routing change executed: removed 10% weight to dedicated-auth for prod-usw2 per oncall-jamie.

alice-dev: Metrics trending stable now — 5xx at 0.9% over the last 5m window, request latency recovered to baseline.

oncall-jamie: Assigning follow-up to daytime SRE for RCA and long-term fixes. @sre-day please take PD-4821 postmortem. Tagging @product-anna and @support-luke for customer comms.

sre-day: Acked. I'll take ownership of the RCA, include logs and proposed config changes. ETA 24h for initial draft.

oncall-jamie: Closing active page; will add notes to PD-4821 and incident tracker. Thanks for the quick response team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4821 status changed to RESOLVED by oncall-jamie.

support-luke: I'll send updates to the affected customers and link the RCA when available.

alice-dev: Leaving a note: collect auth-proxy heap/metrics around token refresh window for next repro attempt.

sre-miguel: Added follow-up tickets: INF-1209 (circuit breaker + timeout), INF-1210 (more robust liveness probe).

oncall-jamie: Hand-off complete. If any regression, reopen PD or ping #incidents. Good job team. :clap:
